rnpi: rnpi — to be young, become young again (verb; stative rnp·kwi 'I am young'; written with the palm-rib and a child as classifier; Budge: renpà)
innytw: innytw — Innitu(?), a god called on to send the ba home (god's name; meaning of the name not known; Budge: Ànnitu)
pḥrr: pḥrr — runner (?) (noun m., perhaps from pḥr 'run, go round'; a title of a god who is called on; meaning doubtful)
wḏfꜣ: wḏfꜣ — to be slow, delay (verb; wḏfꜣw 'there is delay'; Budge: ut'efau)
nfꜣ: nfꜣ — those (?) (demonstrative, plural; the reading and sense are doubtful; Budge: nefai)
ḫꜣ: ḫꜣ — thousand (number m.; written with the lotus leaf; Budge: χa)
ḥrt: ḥrt — sky, what is above (noun f.; from ḥr 'upon'; written with the sky sign; Budge: ḥert)
ꜣmm: ꜣmm — to grasp, seize (?) (verb; written with a fist as classifier; the sense is doubtful; Budge: amem)
mꜥt: mꜥt — staff, sceptre (?) (noun f.; a word not otherwise met, the sense is doubtful; Budge: māta)
ḫpd: ḫpd — a word not identified (meaning not known; Budge: χepṭ, 'persons')
nbw: nbw — gold (noun m.; also the adjective 'golden')
ꜥꜣt: ꜥꜣt — precious stone, costly stone (noun f.; used of stones inlaid in a work)
bꜣw: bꜣw — might, powers (noun m. plural; the plural of bꜣ, used for the manifest power of a god)
ḥwt-ḥr: ḥwt-ḥr — Hathor, goddess of the sky and of love; lit. 'house of Horus' (goddess's name; Budge: Ḥet Ḥeru)
wnt: wnt — enclosure (?), a place that is shut and opened (noun f., from wn 'open'; the sense is doubtful; Budge: unt, 'the place of restraint')
ḫtm: ḫtm — to seal, shut, close (verb; written with the seal on a cord); what is sealed (noun); ḫtmyw 'those who seal' (noun m. plural)
ḫkr: ḫkr — to adorn, deck (verb); ḫkrw 'ornaments, regalia' (noun m. plural; the sense of the verb is doubtful)
pḏ: pḏ — to stretch, extend (verb; pḏ nmtt 'stretch the strides'; Budge: peṭ)
nmtt: nmtt — strides, steps (noun f. plural; from nmt 'step'; Budge: nemmat)
mdw: mdw — word, speech (noun m.); to speak (verb)
iḫḫw: iḫḫw — light (?), rays of light (noun m. plural; written with the sun and its rays as classifier; the sense is doubtful; Budge: àχeχu)
nḏr: nḏr — to grasp, hold fast (verb; the infinitive nḏrt 'holding'; Budge: net'ert, 'possession')

__broaden__.šwt: šwt — feather, plume (noun f.; dual šwty 'the two plumes' of a crown; Budge: śuti) · a second word of the same spelling: shadow, shade (noun f.; one of the parts of a person that can leave the body; written with the sunshade; Budge: χaibit)
__broaden__.nw: nw — Nu, the primeval water · a second word of the same spelling: to look, look out (verb; imperative nw 'look!')
__broaden__.dmi: dmi — town, village, quarter (noun) · also to join, unite (verb; rdit dmi 'letting join'); dmi 'joining, union' (noun; the sense is doubtful; Budge: ṭemà)
__broaden__.nm: nm — who? (interrogative pronoun; later also written with ꜥ, nim) · m nm 'again, a second time' (?) (adverbial phrase; sense uncertain; Budge: em nem) · also to repeat (?) (verb; nm·f 'may he repeat'; from m nm 'again'; the sense is doubtful)
__broaden__.mwt: mwt — mother (noun) · a second word of the same spelling: to die (verb; often written mt, without the w; Budge: mit) · mwtw 'the dead' (noun m. plural; those who have died)
__broaden__.iwi: iwi — to come (verb; participle iw "coming, who comes") · also the infinitive iwt 'coming'; iw 'comes, is coming' (verb; the reading of the form is doubtful in places)
__broaden__.ꜥqꜣ: ꜥqꜣ — straight, exact (adjective; Budge: āqa, 'the middle') · also as a noun, 'straightness, exactness' (the sense is doubtful)
